headings.strategy: Expressive and dense. Use tracking-tight for H1-H3 to ensure a highly polished, professional look. Avoid generic defaults. Font-black or font-light depending on context. For portal stat-headers, use Outfit font-semibold.

body.strategy: High legibility for dense tabular data. Use text-sm for standard dashboard text, text-xs for meta-data and tags.

colors.strategy: White theme predominantly. Use Ink (#0A0A0A) for sharp contrasts, text, and active states. Use the 8-color stripe palette exclusively for semantic highlights (e.g., green for successful scans, red for 'Not visible yet' warnings, cyan for AI generative states, purple/magenta for tags). Do not use generic tailwind blues for primary CTAs, stick to Ink (#0A0A0A) or brand colors.

marketing_site_fixes.pricing_cta: Make sure CTA buttons are wrapped in flex containers with flex-wrap on mobile, or grid-cols-1 on mobile and grid-cols-2 on desktop. Ensure no awkward text wrapping. Add p-4 to buttons, ensure w-full on mobile, auto width on desktop. Must be fully responsive.

portal_shell.structure: Separate authenticated shell. Sidebar (w-64) fixed on left, Topbar fixed on top. Main content area takes up remaining space (calc(100vw-16rem)).
portal_shell.sidebar: Dense, tool-like. Includes navigation items: Dashboard, AI Scan, Opportunities, Pages, Settings. Logout at the bottom with 'Back to Site' button routing back to marketing site.
portal_shell.topbar: Contains page breadcrumbs, user profile, and high-level actions.

onboarding_ai_scan.layout: 2-column grid. Left: Live progress checklist with Framer Motion entering animations (Scanning content... Finding demand... etc). Right: Live-findings panel simulating a Google/LLM search with glowing AI borders using brand cyan/magenta.

opportunities_screen.layout: Bento Grid. Top section: Hero stat '100 Opportunities to Get Found'. Below: Horizontal scroll or grid of top-5 query cards. Middle section: Sample SERP snippet with a warning card '220 searches last month didn't find you'. Bottom: Full width shadcn Data Table with ~100 opportunities.

generated_pages_screen.layout: Grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) for published page cards. Each card uses bento-style internal padding, showing 'Service/Published' tags, title, keyword-cluster chips, and 'Go to Live Page' button.

public_landing_page_template.layout: Standard marketing layout for generated pages. Centered hero, 3-column services grid with 'Book Now' CTAs, single column FAQ accordion. Includes a 'Request Call Back' Lead capture modal form (Full Name, Company, Email, Phone+Country).

leads_dashboard.layout: Dense B2B data view. Top control bar: Search input, 'Show spam' toggle, 'Apply Filters' dropdown, 'Invite', 'Export Report' buttons. Main view: Table with columns (WHEN, NAME, ACTION, STATUS, ADD NOTES inline, VIEW JOURNEY).

visual_enhancers.surface_styles: Use 'Neumorphism / Clay & Crisp' for dashboard cards: Flat background (White or #F9FAFB), 1px solid border (#E5E7EB), subtle shadow-sm. No muddy gradients.
visual_enhancers.ai_elements: For the 'AI Scan' progress and generative moments, use 'The Tracing Beam' (animated 1px border gradient) or a 'Glassmorphism' container with backdrop-blur-xl and a subtle brand stripe gradient behind it.

grids.dashboard_grid: Tight gap (gap-4 or gap-6). Use col-span-1 for summary widgets, col-span-2 or 3 for main data tables. Always use mobile-first responsive grids.

motion.strategy: Micro-interactions for feedback. Staggered list animations for the AI Scan checklist. Hover lifts (-translate-y-1) for generated page cards.

components.name: Sidebar
components.instructions: Use lucide-react icons. Add 'data-testid' to all nav links. Provide active state styling with Ink (#0A0A0A) background and White text.

components.name: DataTable
components.instructions: Use shadcn/ui Table. Ensure dense padding (py-2 px-3) for B2B feel. Left-align text.

components.name: MetricCard
components.instructions: Flat surface, sharp borders, bold Outfit typography for the number.

components.name: AIChecklist
components.instructions: Framer motion staggered children. Active item highlighted, completed items get a green checkmark.

components.name: Badge/Chip
components.instructions: Use the 8-color palette for background tints (e.g., bg-cyan-100 text-cyan-900) for keyword clusters and statuses.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Ink (#0A0A0A) on White/Gray meets APCA/WCAG standards. Do not use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays, always use a blur or semi-solid scrim.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, toggles, nav links) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="sidebar-opportunities-link"').

media.guidelines: Use abstract AI images sparingly to indicate generative actions. Use professional portraits for user avatars or mock CRM data. Never use placeholder texts for logos.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI outputs. Make the portal feel like a high-end data tool.
Do not center align the app container. Left-align dense data.
Avoid generic tailwind blue; stick strictly to the Ink (#0A0A0A) and 8-color stripe palette defined in the brand.
Implement a clear structural divide: The portal (authenticated) MUST NOT share the marketing layout. Implement a completely separate layout wrapper for the portal with a persistent left sidebar.
Fix marketing page pricing CTA buttons to be fully responsive and wrap correctly without awkward overflows.
Use Framer Motion for the AI Scan flow to create an engaging experience.
Add data-testid to every clickable item for testing.
